text: 1、市场早间震荡走强，创业板指涨超2%，科创50指数涨超4%。CPO、PCB等算力硬件股走强，澳弘电子4连板，威尔高、可川科技、光迅科技等多股涨停。半导体芯片股拉升，有研硅、晶升股份、中晶科技、有研新材等涨停。炭黑概念股大涨，龙星科技、黑猫股份涨停。下跌方面，旅游板块下挫，桂林旅游跌停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市近4200股飘红，上午半天成交1.17万亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.57%，深成指涨1.42%，创业板涨2.35%。 2、板块概念方面，算力硬件、半导体芯片、炭黑、贵金属等板块领涨；汽车整车、银行、保险、航运港口等板块领跌； 3、两市共3929只个股上涨
text_en: 1. The market strengthened in choppy morning trading, with the ChiNext Index up more than 2% and the STAR 50 Index up more than 4%. Computing power hardware stocks such as CPO and PCB strengthened, Aohong Electronics hit a fourth consecutive limit-up, and multiple stocks including Wellgao, Kechuan Technology and Accelink Technologies hit the limit-up. Semiconductor chip stocks rallied, with GRITEK, Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical, Zhongjing Technology and Youyan New Material hitting the limit-up. Carbon black concept stocks surged, with Longxing Technology and Black Cat hit the limit-up. On the downside, the tourism sector fell, with Guilin Tourism hitting the limit-down. More stocks rose than fell, with nearly 4,200 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets gaining, and half-day turnover of RMB 1.17 trillion. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.57%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.42%, and ChiNext rose 2.35%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, computing power hardware, semiconductor chips, carbon black and precious metals led the gains; complete vehicles, banks, insurance and shipping ports led the declines; 3. A total of 3,929 stocks in the two markets rose
